# Runbook: team-ai

<!-- GENERATED by docs/runbooks/gen_runbooks.py from platform-gitops/envs/services/team-ai.yaml. Edit the template or generator, not this file. -->

| | |
|---|---|
| Namespace | `marketplace` (local), `marketplace-staging` (staging on kind) (not deployed in the kind staging overlay) |
| Port | 8000 (container port) |
| Health | HTTP `/healthz` and gRPC health on 50060 |
| Image tag | `platform-gitops/envs/<env>/values.yaml` -> `images.team-ai` |
| Logs | `kubectl -n marketplace logs deploy/team-ai --tail=200` |

## Dependencies
- `REDIS_HOST=valkey`
- `RECS_QDRANT_URL=http://qdrant:6333`
- Vault via ExternalSecret (`svc/team-ai/config` -> Secret `team-ai-env`); a missing secret shows as `CreateContainerConfigError`

## Alerts that can point here
- `ServiceDown` (`up{job="team-ai"} == 0` for 1m): pod not ready or `/metrics` unreachable on 8000.
Alert delivery in the local stack: Alertmanager -> `webhook-logger` (`kubectl -n marketplace logs deploy/webhook-logger`). See `docs/runbooks/alerts.md`.

## Triage
1. `kubectl -n marketplace get pods -l app=team-ai` then `kubectl -n marketplace describe pod -l app=team-ai | tail -30` (probe failures, OOMKilled, image pull).
2. `kubectl -n marketplace logs deploy/team-ai --tail=200`: look for dependency errors from the list above.
3. Check the dependencies first (`kubectl -n marketplace get pods`), then this service.
4. Recent change? `kubectl -n argocd get application team-ai -o wide` and compare `images.team-ai` with the previous tag in git.

## Rollback
Plain Deployment (no canary). Revert the tag in git, then publish:
`scripts/rollback.sh team-ai --env local --to <good-tag> && make -C deploy gitops-push`
(this edits `images.team-ai`; with `--env staging` for the staging overlay). A bare `kubectl rollout undo` is reverted by ArgoCD selfHeal.
